map.输入同一组对象的配对测量值（如服药前后），计算每对差值及其均值与标准差，用配对: Enter paired measurements of the same subjects (such as before and after medication), compute the difference for each pair along with its mean and standard deviation, and use a paired t-test to judge whether the difference is significantly non-zero, outputting the t statistic, degrees of freedom and p value for pre-post controlled experiments.
map.填写「差值标准差 s_d」。: Enter the standard deviation of the differences s_d.
map.填写「配对数 n」。: Enter the number of pairs n.
map.同体前后测差异：t=d̄/(sd/√n)，df=n−1。: Pre-post comparison within the same subjects: t = d_mean/(sd/sqrt(n)), df = n-1.
map.消除个体间变异、提高灵敏度。: Eliminates between-individual variation and raises sensitivity.
map.如用药前后血压差。: Such as the blood pressure difference before and after medication.
With d_mean = 3, sd of differences = 4 and n = 20: t = 3/(4/sqrt20) = 3/0.894 = about 3.354, df = 19. The critical value is about 2.093, so it is significant (p<0.01) and the intervention is effective.
map.：d̄=0.5：t=0.5/0.894≈0.56，不显著。: With d_mean = 0.5: t = 0.5/0.894 = about 0.56, not significant.
map.由两组样本量方差求合并方差: Pooled variance from two sample variances
map.为何用配对而非独立 t？: Why paired instead of independent t?
map.配对控制个体基线差异，误差更小、功效更高；前提是同一对象前后或配对设计。: Pairing controls for individual baseline differences, giving smaller error and higher power; the premise is that the same subjects are measured before and after, or that the design is paired.
map.差值需正态？: Do the differences need to be normal?
map.要求差值近似正态，n 大时中心极限可放宽。: The differences are required to be approximately normal, and for large n the central limit theorem relaxes this.
